member.name: T:Raksawi.Observability.CouchDbUrlPolicy
member.summary: CouchDB is HTTP, so it arrives as ordinary client spans with no db.* attributes. That makes it cheap to instrument and moves the entire database risk into the URL — see ADR-0023.

member.name: M:Raksawi.Observability.CouchDbUrlPolicy.IsChangesFeed(System.Uri)
member.summary: The continuous changes feed is a long-poll held open for minutes. Traced as an ordinary client span it produces spans of arbitrary duration that corrupt every latency percentile computed from span data.

member.name: M:Raksawi.Observability.CouchDbUrlPolicy.Redact(System.Uri)
member.summary: Replaces document identifiers and view keys with placeholders, keeping the shape of the request — which is the diagnostically useful part — and discarding the values, which are where identity can appear.
member.remarks: GET /kyc/abc-123 becomes GET /kyc/{docid}. GET /kyc/_design/d/_view/v?key="x" becomes GET /kyc/_design/d/_view/v?key={value}.

member.name: T:Raksawi.Observability.RaksawiObservability
member.summary: .NET Framework 4.8 entry point. Called from Application_Start; the returned handle is disposed in Application_End.

remarks.para: Built from the first commit per ADR-0012 and unvalidated until Phase 2 per ADR-0005 — the three documented 4.8 failure modes are reproduced against a fixture before this path is trusted. ADR-0022 defers that past the demo.
This does not wire TelemetryHttpModule, which must be registered in Web.config, and IIS must run in integrated pipeline mode.

member.name: M:Raksawi.Observability.RaksawiObservability.Start(System.Action{Raksawi.Observability.RaksawiObservabilityOptions})
member.summary: Starts telemetry. Never throws for telemetry reasons: a service must be able to start without a collector (Rev 3 I3.6).

member.name: P:Raksawi.Observability.RaksawiObservability.Handle.W3CWarning
member.summary: Non-null when the trace context format had to be corrected. Surfaced rather than logged, because there is no logging abstraction to assume on this runtime.

member.name: T:Raksawi.Observability.RaksawiObservabilityOptions
member.summary: Configuration for the observability stack. Deliberately small: the values here are the ones that differ per service or per environment, and nothing else is configurable.

member.name: P:Raksawi.Observability.RaksawiObservabilityOptions.ServiceName
member.summary: Bare service name, kebab-case, per ADR-0006. Never derived from a deployment-owned name such as a hostname, container name, or app pool.

member.name: P:Raksawi.Observability.RaksawiObservabilityOptions.ServiceNamespace
member.summary: The domain this service belongs to, per ADR-0006.

member.name: P:Raksawi.Observability.RaksawiObservabilityOptions.ServiceInstanceId
member.summary: Stable identity for this instance, per ADR-0008. Supplied via OTEL_SERVICE_INSTANCE_ID when known; derived from the host when not. An app pool recycle does not change it.

member.name: P:Raksawi.Observability.RaksawiObservabilityOptions.OtlpEndpoint
member.summary: OTLP endpoint. http/protobuf on 4318 — gRPC on 4317 is unsupported on .NET Framework and closed estate-wide.

member.name: P:Raksawi.Observability.RaksawiObservabilityOptions.SamplingRatio
member.summary: Head sampling ratio. Absent configuration is a production boot failure per ADR-0010; this default applies only when .

member.name: P:Raksawi.Observability.RaksawiObservabilityOptions.IsDevelopment
member.summary: When true, an absent defaults to 1.0 instead of failing the boot.

member.name: P:Raksawi.Observability.RaksawiObservabilityOptions.CouchDbHosts
member.summary: Hosts whose outbound HTTP calls are CouchDB. Used to apply the ADR-0023 URL treatment, since CouchDB is indistinguishable from any other HTTP dependency at the instrumentation layer.

member.name: P:Raksawi.Observability.RaksawiObservabilityOptions.RedactCouchDbUrls
member.summary: Redact document identifiers and view keys out of CouchDB URLs. Answered by demo phase D0 (QD2): if CouchDB document IDs are derived from applicant data this must be true, and telemetry must not be enabled against real data until it is.

member.name: P:Raksawi.Observability.RaksawiObservabilityOptions.ActivitySources
member.summary: ActivitySource names belonging to the application itself. NATS.Net's own source is registered automatically and does not belong here.

member.name: F:Raksawi.Observability.RaksawiObservabilityOptions.NatsActivitySourceName
member.summary: NATS.Net emits publish and subscribe spans and propagates trace context through message headers on its own, from version 3.0.1. Nothing injects traceparent by hand, and no custom message counters are needed.

member.name: T:Raksawi.Observability.ServiceIdentity
member.summary: Resource identity and the trace-context format check. Both runtimes compile this file, which is the point of the multi-target: governance lives in the shared compilation rather than in per-runtime wiring instructions (ADR-0001).

member.name: M:Raksawi.Observability.ServiceIdentity.EnsureW3CTraceContext
member.summary: Forces the W3C trace context format. Default on .NET 5+, but on .NET Framework, where the failure is silent: traces split in two rather than erroring.
member.returns: Null when the format was already correct, otherwise a warning describing what was corrected. Per ADR-0005 this warns and never throws — telemetry setup must not be able to fail a service start (Rev 3 I3.6).

member.name: M:Raksawi.Observability.ServiceIdentity.ResolveInstanceId(Raksawi.Observability.RaksawiObservabilityOptions)
member.summary: ADR-0008: supplied if known, derived if not. The derived form must be stable across an app pool recycle, so nothing process-scoped is used.
